verdict.rationale: The v1 API lets users read scan, repository, and vulnerability data programmatically (JSON via OpenAPI), which provides a technical path to export findings data, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature, no mention of open-format guarantees for full account data, and no offboarding/exit workflow. missing for 10: explicit full-data export tooling, documented open-format (e.g. CSV/JSON) export guarantee, and account-closure/data-portability policy.
